slides.h: Phase 3 closed — cosmological natural selection, audited
b: 3 tracks, 3 gates passed. One held first, correctly.

slides.h: The prediction that failed was not the theory's
b: Smolin's own falsifier is a pulsar above 2.5 solar masses. The heaviest well-measured star is 6 sigma short.
What failed is Brown and Bethe's ceiling, which the theory used as an instrument — not as a prediction.

slides.h: Both corrections were of my own work
b: A gate caught me shaping the evidence to repeat an earlier result.
Then a finding I filed against our own record was reversed one paper later.

slides.h: Report published, cockpit corrected, work committed
b: 5 commits. A factual error on the lane page is fixed and disclosed.

slides.h: Two caveats travel with all of it
b: Track C rests on an unpublished preprint — both published sources are still out of reach.
Every gate today was a fresh reader, not a second engine.
